papers.title_en: On the Equivalence of Stochastic Control and Path Space Formulations for Schrödinger Bridges over Compact Connected Lie Groups
papers.authors: Hamza Mahmood, Georgiy A. Bondar, Abhishek Halder, Adeel Akhtar
papers.evidence: 薛定谔桥的随机控制与路径空间表述等价
papers.tldr: 本文研究紧连通李群上运动学方程的薛定谔桥问题（SBP），旨在打通随机最优控制与路径空间两种表述。作者借助水平提升与随机反发展，建立Girsanov型测度变换，证明期望控制能量等于受控路径律相对参考Wiener测度的相对熵。由此SBP等价于在端点边际约束下最小化路径空间相对熵。该等价性支撑SB的存在唯一性、概率解释，并可用静态Sinkhorn递归直接求解；在二维环面T^2上给出数值验证。
papers.abstract_en: We establish the equivalence between the stochastic optimal control and path space formulations of the Schrödinger bridge problem (SBP) for the kinematic equation on a compact connected Lie group. Using the geometric concepts of horizontal lift and stochastic anti-development, we derive a Girsanov-type change-of-measure result, and show that the expected control energy equals the relative entropy of the controlled path law with respect to the reference Wiener measure. Thus, the SBP is equivalently a path space relative entropy minimization problem subject to prescribed endpoint marginals.Our result has three useful implications. From an analytic viewpoint, the shown equivalence helps prove the existence and uniqueness of the SB. From a probabilistic viewpoint, it helps interpret the SB as the most probable deviation of the uncontrolled stochastic dynamics consistent with the endpoint constraints. From a computational viewpoint, it allows using static Sinkhorn recursions to directly solve the relative entropy minimization problem and compute the optimal path measure. We illustrate the equivalence numerically on the torus $\mathbb{T}^2$. The code is publicly available at: https://github.com/gradslab/LargeDeviationSBP

papers.title_en: Physical-State-Guided Diffusion Sampling for Full-Waveform Inversion
papers.authors: Chen Min, Haowen Jiang, Zheng Ma, Xiongbin Yan
papers.evidence: 通过高斯桥将扩散先验与物理状态耦合
papers.tldr: 全波形反演（FWI）因强非线性与不适定性，严重依赖初始化和先验。扩散后验采样可提供地质先验，但直接将去噪器耦合非线性波动方程会带来不可靠的物理引导。本文提出物理状态引导扩散采样（PSG），用高斯桥将持续演化的物理速度与扩散先验耦合，使波形拟合正则化物理状态、物理状态再引导反向扩散，并分离波动方程与去噪器梯度。在四个 OpenFWI 数据集上，PSG 的终端去噪估计优于经典和扩散基线，且在缺失道与噪声下保持结构恢复；冻结先验还能无需重训反演 Marmousi 等更大模型。
papers.abstract_en: Full waveform inversion (FWI) estimates subsurface velocity from seismic recordings, but its ill-posedness and nonlinearity make accurate reconstruction strongly dependent on initialization and prior information. Diffusion posterior sampling provides a learned geological prior, yet directly coupling its denoiser to the nonlinear wave solver can yield unreliable physical guidance. We propose Physical-State-Guided Diffusion Sampling (PSG), which couples a persistent physical velocity to the diffusion prior through a Gaussian bridge. The physical state is refined by waveform fitting regularized by the denoised velocity, and in turn guides the reverse diffusion process. This formulation separates the wave-equation and denoiser gradients while preserving conventional FWI initialization and accumulated optimization history. On four OpenFWI families, PSG's terminal denoised estimates outperform classical and diffusion-based baselines under clean and missing-trace acquisitions and maintain strong structural recovery under measurement noise. Repeated stochastic runs preserve the dominant geological structures, with ensemble variability concentrated near geological interfaces and positively associated with local inversion error. A frozen OpenFWI-trained prior further supports inversion of the larger Marmousi, Overthrust, and BP2004 Salt models, recovering complex geological structures without retraining.

papers.evidence: 生成式模型条件弱收敛到P-布朗桥，涵盖分数扩散模型
papers.tldr: 论文研究从拟合生成分布重采样得到的生成 bootstrap 过程，关注其条件弱收敛到 P-Brownian bridge 的刻画。作者以有限维条件弱收敛与条件渐近等度连续为条件，给出充要条件，并提供一般充分条件及 Giné-Zinn 型 P-Donsker 性质对应。最后在三角归一化流、flow matching、分数扩散模型与 Wasserstein GAN 等生成模型中验证这些条件。
papers.abstract_en: We study generative bootstrap processes obtained by resampling from fitted generative distributions. We establish necessary and sufficient conditions for their conditional weak convergence to the $P$-Brownian bridge, formulated in terms of finite-dimensional conditional weak convergence and conditional asymptotic equicontinuity. We further provide general sufficient conditions and a Giné-Zinn-type characterization relating this convergence to the $P$-Donsker property. As applications, we verify these conditions for prominent classes of generative models, including triangular normalizing flows, flow matching, score-based diffusion models, and Wasserstein generative adversarial networks.

papers.title_en: CyclOT: Learning Quadratic Optimal Transport Maps via Synchronized Forward-Backward Interpolants
papers.authors: Shizhou Xu, Jiachen Liu, Shih-Hsin Wang, Stefan Broecker, Yuhao Huang, Bao Wang, Thomas Strohmer
papers.evidence: 通过前后向位移插值学习最优传输映射
papers.tldr: 从无配对高维样本中同时恢复正反二次最优传输映射是关键难题。CyclOT构建双向神经框架，让学到的映射诱导前后向位移插值，并用双向二次作用量、判别器约束的Jensen-Shannon端点目标与双边循环一致性联合训练。理论上在紧凸支撑与生成器/判别器条件下证明总体恢复：任意精度下，全局最优解到正反Brenier映射的L2误差之和可低于该精度，且循环损失受λW2^2控制。实验在Swiss roll、MNIST、CelebA、单细胞扰动与胸片等验证端点保真、传输代价与逆一致性。
papers.abstract_en: We study the recovery of forward and reverse quadratic optimal-transport maps from unpaired samples in high dimensions. We introduce a bidirectional neural framework in which the learned maps induce forward and backward displacement interpolants, while the training objective combines bidirectional quadratic action, discriminator-restricted Jensen-Shannon endpoint objectives, and two-sided cycle consistency. The construction requires neither precomputed sample pairings nor an explicit convex-potential parameterization. For absolutely continuous probability measures supported on a compact convex set, and under the stated generator-approximation, discriminator-richness, and minimizer-attainment conditions, we prove a population recovery theorem: for every prescribed accuracy, the sum of the corresponding \(L^2\) errors between any global minimizer and the forward and reverse quadratic Brenier maps is below that accuracy, provided the discriminator level is sufficiently large and the annealing action weight becomes sufficiently small. Moreover, the cycle loss is bounded above by \(λW_2^2(μ_0,μ_1)\). Complementary results quantify approximate invertibility and show that exact endpoint Jensen-Shannon divergence and cycle consistency control missing target mass and many-to-one map collapse, respectively. Experiments on Swiss roll, MNIST, CelebA, single-cell perturbation data, and chest X-ray images evaluate endpoint fidelity, transport cost, inverse consistency, and the geometry of the induced interpolations.

papers.title_en: Backward SDEs-based Diffusion for Physics-Constrained Generation
papers.evidence: 基于得分SDE先验的终端条件反演与倒向SDE
papers.tldr: 预训练分数扩散模型提供强无条件先验，但逆问题中的测量/物理一致性常依赖启发式引导、间歇投影或任务条件训练，终端可行性缺乏保证。本文提出面向Score-SDE先验的终端条件反演，构造后向随机微分方程，把终端可行性约束映射到选定噪声层级的先验状态。作者证明适应解存在唯一性，并设计神经BSDE求解器，无需改动分数系数即可融合预训练扩散先验与领域约束。实验在玩具数据验证稳定反演与邻域采样，稀疏视角CT重建优于免训练基线且满足严格测量可行性。
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained score-based diffusion models provide strong unconditional priors, yet enforcing measurement or physics consistency in inverse problems is often handled by heuristic guidance, intermittent projections, or task-specific conditional training, with limited guarantees of feasibility at the end of inference. We propose terminal-conditioned inversion for score-based SDE priors. Given a frozen Score-SDE prior and a task-defined terminal feasibility specification, we construct an associated backward stochastic differential equation whose adapted solution defines a principled inverse map from the terminal requirement to a prior state at a chosen noise level. Under standard regularity conditions, we establish existence and uniqueness of the adapted solution and obtain terminal consistency by construction. We further develop a practical neural BSDE solver that composes arbitrary pretrained diffusion priors with domain constraints without modifying the score-defined coefficients, producing an anchored prior state that enables neighborhood sampling for uncertainty characterization. Experiments on toy datasets validate stable terminal-conditioned inversion and distributionally consistent neighborhood sampling. As a real-world case study, we apply the framework to sparse-view CT reconstruction and achieve improved reconstruction quality over representative training-free baselines while satisfying strict measurement feasibility under the prescribed terminal specification. Project is available in: \href{https://laplacelab.github.io/BSDEDiffusion/}{https://laplace.center/icmlbsdeI/}
